task: Fix the incorrect time zone handling in the scheduled job after the server time zone was changed.

candidate_memories.content: Scheduled jobs are running 5 hours late after the server time zone was changed from UTC to EST.
All job schedules must be specified in UTC; the cron expressions must not change when server time zones change.
The server time zone was changed by the infrastructure team to align with the new data center location.
Cron expressions must always use UTC as the reference time zone regardless of server time zone settings.
The time zone change affected only the job scheduler; the API server still uses UTC internally.
The job scheduler is Quartz with a PostgreSQL job store for persistence.
Session 6 note: the data team added three new scheduled reports to the job scheduler.
Old practice: cron schedules were specified in local server time in the early version of the scheduler.
The data center migration from US-East to US-West was completed on March 20.
Session 11 note: the scheduler monitoring dashboard was updated to show next-run times in UTC.
Old scheduler guide: the time zone for job schedules was inherited from the JVM default time zone.
Job schedules must be anchored to a fixed time zone reference to prevent drift after server moves.
Session 4 note: the scheduler was upgraded from Quartz 2.3 to 2.4 for improved clustering support.
Jobs that process daily reports use a 00:00 UTC schedule to align with the data warehouse refresh.
A scheduler health check in session 9 showed all jobs running within 1 minute of their scheduled time.
The job scheduler cluster has 3 nodes with leader election for single-run guarantees.
UTC-anchored schedules avoid daylight saving time issues that cause jobs to run at unexpected times.
Session 7 note: the billing team requested a new scheduled job for monthly invoice generation.
Old scheduler config: the time zone was explicitly set to UTC in the config file before the data center move.
Job execution history is retained for 90 days and is queryable via the scheduler admin API.
